name: portfolio-backend
description: Golang Backend API for Portfolio running on Cloudflare Workers (WebAssembly)

scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('go run github.com/syumai/workers-go/cmd/workers-assets-gen -mode=go', { stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('go build -o ./build/app.wasm .', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, GOOS: 'js', GOARCH: 'wasm' } });"
